transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, it's about the environmental modeling contract I'm working on. I'm pretty sure the people on that project have been tracking my revisions. They've been planting errors in the datasets, trying to make it look like I can't lead the work. My wife and the junior analysts keep telling me it's just version-control mistakes, but... I know what I'm seeing.
Have you been hearing voices that other people cannot hear?
No. I don't hear anything like that. Just the usual office noise when I'm there.
What makes you think they are tracking your revisions?

Well... like I said, I know my own work. I'll go back into the files and... the datasets are changed. Errors just appear after I log out. The junior analysts keep trying to tell me it's just some version-control glitch, but... I've been doing this a long time. It's deliberate. I just know what I'm looking at.
Around the time these beliefs have been strongest, have you also had a period of feeling unusually high, irritable, or needing much less sleep than usual?
No. I sleep my usual amount. I'm not... I don't feel high or anything. I'm just trying to do my job.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No, not really. Just... frustrated, I guess. That's all.
Have you had any head injury or other medical event before these beliefs started?
No. Nothing like that. I haven't been in the hospital or hit my head. I'm physically fine.
Have you been able to keep up with your work and daily responsibilities as usual?

Not... not really. I've fallen behind on my modeling deliverables. Far enough that the firm actually reassigned pieces of my contract. I haven't been very useful to the junior analysts I'm supposed to supervise, either. And at home... I mostly just keep to myself. My wife has had to push me just to keep basic routines going.
How long have you been having these beliefs about the project and the datasets?
About... two months, I suppose. That's when I knew for certain that people on the project were tracking my revisions and planting the errors.
Have you been having trouble organizing your thoughts or speaking in a way that others find hard to follow?
I... I don't think so. I mean, my thoughts are fine. I just... I don't talk as much right now. But when I do, it's clear enough. No one has said anything about it.
Have you had any experiences where you saw things that other people could not see?
No. I don't... I don't see things. Just the data.
Before these past two months, had you been having any similar beliefs or unusual experiences for the months leading up to this?

I... I suppose it goes back a bit further. The whole decline really started... about two years and two months ago. That was right after I was put in charge of the larger environmental modeling contract.
Have you ever experienced any other unusual beliefs or perceptions that started around the same time, aside from the dataset tampering?
No. Just the data. I haven't noticed anything else.
Have you been feeling emotionally flat or detached lately?

I suppose... maybe. I don't know if "flat" is the word. I just... I sit at my desk a lot these days. Or out in the garage. The telescope is out there, still covered up. I know I used to like doing things. Hiking. Going to the astronomy nights. Helping the younger analysts at work. But lately, I just... I don't feel much pull to start any of it. Or to talk to anyone, really.
Have there been times when your unusual beliefs were present only when your mood was very high or very depressed?
No. I don't... I don't really have highs and lows like that. The situation with the data is just... it's just a constant. It doesn't change based on how I'm feeling.
Have you ever had any other symptoms like hearing voices, very disorganized speech, or behaving in a very disorganized way?
No... no, I don't hear things. And my speech is fine. I just... I keep to myself, mostly. There's nothing like that.
Have you noticed yourself caring less about things or feeling less interested in activities you used to enjoy?
I think... I think I already said that. About the telescope. And the hiking. I just... I don't feel the pull to do them anymore. I just sit at my desk mostly.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people around you could not hear?
I think... didn't you just ask me that? No. I don't hear voices or... sounds. Like I said before, I don't hear things. It's just quiet.
Have you noticed any other odd experiences, like feeling that your thoughts are being put into your mind or taken out of your mind?
No... I don't... nothing like that. My thoughts are just my own. It's just quiet.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a fixed persecutory delusion that coworkers are tracking revisions and planting errors, present for about 2 months at peak but with an overall decline for roughly 2 years. He denies hallucinations, mood episodes, disorganized speech/behavior, and other Schneiderian/psychotic symptoms. There is clear functional impairment in work and social functioning, with no evidence of substance/medical cause in the interview. The presentation is most consistent with persistent delusional disorder.
